status: B1–B12 implemented and locally verified; explicitly open platform/live/rendered/store-review gates

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: `ContactsDatabase._enqueue` began SQL transactions outside its completion handling; rollback could replace the primary error. The whole lifecycle now settles the operation and gate in `finally`, tracks successful BEGIN, preserves cleanup diagnostics and invalidates an unrecoverable connection. `_close` independently drains resources.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Actual SQLCipher adapter BEGIN/body/COMMIT/ROLLBACK injection, bounded operation/shutdown and subsequent-operation assertions in `test/storage/transaction_failure_test.dart`; encrypted restart, awaited isolation and rollback retained. Pass.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: BusyMax reauthorization persisted an enabled replacement then disabled it through `disconnect`. `enableLinkedContacts`, staged authorization and `ContactsDirectory.detach` now preserve the working connection through consent, commit validated replacement scopes/generation, drain the old binding without disabling the replacement, and bind its generation.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Actual store/controller Google and Microsoft first enable, upgrade/reconnect, cancellation/wrong identity/partial grant/persistence failure, restart and sync in `test/contacts/contacts_enrollment_test.dart`. Pass.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: BusyMax source preferences committed without publishing configuration changes; Settings detached writes. Both store operations and post-commit notifications now have a close boundary; Settings controls pending/error state and versions reloads.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Actual Settings switches, failed persistence rollback, immediate state, source eligibility and durable restart fixtures; no unrelated sync needed. Pass.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: The actual Fluent Windows and Android Settings routes had no enrollment actions. Their native contacts panels now call the existing controller for linked Google/Microsoft read/write, reconnect/disable/remove/source selection and independent CardDAV/Nextcloud read/write setup.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Eight route-level backend/platform fixtures starting with no contacts; cancellation, enrollment, source selection, read-only state, write upgrade and removal. Pass. Native host results are separate below.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: Attendee requests only fenced query text. All three production attendee controls now capture/revalidate query, selected account and eligible sources, subscribe to configuration changes and invalidate on selection/add/removal/disposal without deleting draft attendees.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Twenty-one actual Linux/Fluent/Android controls fixtures for visible/delayed A→B, selection, source disable/removal and disposal; original manual-entry/metadata/permission preservation suites retained. Pass.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: `GraphClient.download` omitted ordinary confirmed-401 recovery used by `request`. Streaming now permits one ordinary recovery and one claims replay before payload, bounded across alternating rejection types. Cancellation, range/headers/account authorization and no replay after payload remain.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Seven direct streaming regressions; actual BusyMax calendar/To Do attachment caller fixtures; BusyBox integrated Graph mail/download/upload/security coverage in its complete final suite. Pass.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: BusyMax detached sync failures were recorded but remained unobserved futures; cleanup could stop at a failed operation. `_launch`, per-account status generation and enrollment/sync ownership observe scheduled errors and drain on close, preserving awaitable manual failures.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Actual caller-zone scheduled offline/revoked failure, another successful account, manual error, removal/cancellation and shutdown fixtures. No uncaught scheduled error. Pass.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: BusyBox reconstructed full replacement fields from one email/display name. `ContactBrowserDialog` builds patches from the full selected record and actual edits, preserves other values/native metadata and structured names, supports intentional clear, explicit new destination, read-only gates and dirty navigation. Save captures identity/destination/edit generation and mounted state.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Actual dialog/controller/shared Google/Microsoft/CardDAV serialized requests and durable results, repeated emails/labels/IDs/unknown parameters, unchanged Save, name/email-only edits, clear, dirty cancel/switch and close/selection during Save. Google structured-name input edits `givenName`, since `displayName` is output-only. Pass.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: BusyBox treated every returned mutation as success and could create a fresh logical mutation after an unknown create. The editor captures `onStaged` journal ID before dispatch; only confirmed state is saved. Failed/conflict/unknown drafts persist and reopen, known retry uses its ID and uncertain writes reconcile before replay.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Returned validation/permission failure, retryable failure, conflict, timeout-after-dispatch, restart, repeated Save dispatch count and account disable/removal recovery tests. No new create while its logical create is unresolved. Pass. No exactly-once guarantee is claimed.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: Independent DAV sources had no production mail association, editing-mode action or eligibility invalidation. Native Settings exposes separate association, suggestion preference and read/write mode, reconnect and lifecycle actions. Independent links unlink on parent removal; dependent OAuth accounts follow authorization ownership.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Actual Settings→CardDAV/Nextcloud discovery→scoped real composer suggestions, restart, read-only/write, reconnect/association/removal, preference failure, out-of-order loads and stale visible/delayed suggestions. Native shell workflow also exercised. Pass.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: Enrollment lived outside account transition ownership; Google commit/restore minted fresh authority for stale staged results. `ContactsEnrollmentAuthority`, owned enrollment resources and staged original credential authority now fence identity/registration/tenant/generation throughout consent/commit/conditional rollback. Microsoft retains Java/MSAL and protected conditional cache stages. DAV partial durable commits retain recoverable credentials/state.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Real AccountManager/controller/store OAuth loopback/RSA fixtures and framed helper contract cover enable/upgrade/reconnect, cancellation/wrong/partial grant/store failure, removal after authorization, rollback versus newer credentials/removal, old refresh, close and DAV partial failures/restart. Java/helper and positive isolated Secret Service/cache fixtures pass. SQLite and Secret Service remain separate stores with staged recovery, not a claimed atomic transaction.

corrections.root_cause_and_changed_boundary: BusyBox scheduled/discovery failures lacked an explicit observer/status; store close could skip stream cleanup after failed `Future.wait`, with untracked link/preference writes. Controller owns enrollment and sync; every public store operation is tracked, rejects after closing starts, notifies only after durable success while open, and cleanup proceeds after failures. BusyMax uses the equivalent boundary.
corrections.regression_and_actual_outcome: Actual caller-zone controller failures, one failure plus one success, manual errors, failing transaction/link save close, writes-after-close, idempotent close and shared mail DB usability; source Settings errors/versioned reloads. Additive schema 10 preserves schema-8 upgrade and existing schema-9 mail/contact data. Pass.
